title: tutoring
description: Find and book verified 1-on-1 online tutors: search by subject, price and rating, then book.
summary: Find and book verified 1-on-1 online tutors: search by subject, price and rating, then book.
offersHint: Find and book verified 1-on-1 online tutors: search by subject, price and rating, then book. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://itutoronline.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_tutors
toolsPreview.description: Search iTutorOnline's verified tutor directory. Filter by subject/keyword, country, spoken language, max hourly price (EUR), and minimum rating. Returns ranked tutor cards with rates, ratings, and profile links.

toolsPreview.name: get_tutor
toolsPreview.description: Get the full public profile for one tutor by their user id (the id shown in search results or in a /tutor-profile/<id> URL): headline, description, subjects, academic levels, rate, rating, credentials, languages, and how to book.

toolsPreview.name: get_tutor_reviews
toolsPreview.description: Get recent written reviews and the average score for a tutor, by their user id.

toolsPreview.name: list_subjects
toolsPreview.description: List the subjects tutors teach, with the search terms and synonyms that match each. Use before search_tutors to pick a good subject term.

toolsPreview.name: get_platform_info
toolsPreview.description: Explain how iTutorOnline works: pricing, the free first 30 minutes, hour packages, languages of instruction, how booking works, and the live count of verified tutors.

toolsPreview.name: prepare_booking
toolsPreview.description: Assemble a real tutoring booking for a parent/student to finish in one tap. Give the tutor id, how long, who it is for, and optionally a preferred time. Returns a price estimate, a booking brief, and the link the human opens to confirm and pay. Creates nothing and charges nothing itself.

toolsPreview.name: request_human_tutor
toolsPreview.description: Hand a tutoring request to the iTutorOnline team so they can line up a human tutor. Provide the subject and any details; optionally a contact email. Also returns tutors the student can book immediately.
